quotes.text: Evening is the gentle pause between what you did and what you dream.
Let the setting sun take today's worries with it.
Good evening! Slow down and notice how far you have come.
Sunsets remind us that endings can be beautiful too.
As the sky turns golden, let your heart turn grateful.
Evenings are for tea, conversation and quiet thanks.
The day is done; be proud of the effort, not just the outcome.
Soft light, soft thoughts — enjoy this peaceful evening.
